result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with Fourier-type integrals of the form ∫ e^{yyi+2yxi}/(e^{y√π}+e^{-y√π}) dy, shifted contours with ε = e^{πi/4}, and their use for integrals ∫ x^{s-1}/(e^{xε√π}-e^{-xε√π}) dx related to the Riemann–Siegel / zeta function representation.
result.transcription:
$2e^{-\frac{1}{2}yy}\int_0^\infty e^{-2yx-xx}x^{s-1}\partial x = \Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)u \,\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}u' = 2e^{-\frac12 yy}\sum\int_0^\infty e^{-2yx}\sum\frac{x^{2n}(-1)^n}{n!}x^{s-1}\partial x = 2e^{-\frac12 yy}\sum\frac{\Pi(2n+s-1)(-1)^n}{n!(2y)^{2n+s}} = 2^{1-s}\Pi(s-1)e^{-\frac12 yy}y^{-s}(1+\dots)$

$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{yyi+2yxi}}{e^{y\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = Q$

$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{yyi+2yxi}}{e^{y\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = Q-\sqrt\pi e^{-\frac14\pi i-\sqrt\pi x} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{yyi-2y\sqrt\pi)+2yxi-2\sqrt\pi x}}{e^{y\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\sqrt\pi}}\partial y$
$\sqrt\pi(e^{y\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\sqrt\pi}) = 2\sqrt\pi\, i \quad \frac{-2\pi i}{2\sqrt\pi i} = -\sqrt\pi'$
$y=\frac12\sqrt\pi i \quad | 2\sqrt\pi i$
$Q(e^{2\sqrt\pi x}+1)-\sqrt\pi e^{-\frac14\pi i}e^{\sqrt\pi x} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{yyi+2yxi-y\sqrt\pi}\partial y$

$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-yy-2yx}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = Q \quad \varepsilon^2=i \quad \varepsilon=e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}$
$\int_{-\infty+\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}^{\infty+\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}\frac{e^{-yy-2yx}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = Q+i\sqrt\pi e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-yy-2yx-2\varepsilon\sqrt\pi y-2\varepsilon\sqrt\pi x}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\partial y$

$y=\frac12\varepsilon\sqrt\pi$
$\frac{-2\pi i}{\varepsilon\sqrt\pi\cdot 2i} = \varepsilon^3\sqrt\pi \qquad Q(1+e^{2\varepsilon\sqrt\pi x})+i\sqrt\pi e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi} = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty}e^{-yy-2yx-\varepsilon\sqrt\pi y}\partial y = \sqrt\pi\, e^{+(x+\frac{\varepsilon}{2}\sqrt\pi)^2}$
$Q(e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}) = -i\sqrt\pi+\sqrt\pi e^{xx+\frac{\pi}{4}i}$

$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-yy-2yx+y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = \frac{1}{e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}(-\sqrt\pi+\sqrt\pi e^{xx+x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi})$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-yy-2yx+y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\partial y = \frac{\sqrt\pi}{e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}(1-e^{xx-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi})$
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-yy+y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}{e^{y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}+e^{-y\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}\int_0^\infty e^{-2yx-xx}x^{s-1}\partial x\,\partial y = \sqrt\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-xx}}{e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}x^{s-1}\partial x + \sqrt\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{1}{e^{2x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}-1}x^{s-1}\partial x$

$\sqrt\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-xx}}{e^{x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\varepsilon\sqrt\pi}}x^{s-1}\partial x$
$\frac{1}{e^{z\pi i}-e^{-z\pi i}} = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{(-1)^n}{z-n} = \frac{-1}{2\pi i}\sum_1^\infty\int_0^\infty(-1)^n e^{-ny+yz}\partial y+\frac{1}{2\pi i}\sum_0^\infty\int_0^\infty(-1)^n e^{-ny-yz}\partial y$
$1>z>0$
$= \frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{yz}}{e^y+1}\partial y+\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-yz}}{1+e^{-y}}\partial y$

$-\sqrt\pi\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{xxi}}{e^{x\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\sqrt\pi}}-\frac{1}{2x\sqrt\pi}x^{s-1}\partial x$

$[-\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{\pi zzi}}{e^{z\pi}-e^{-z\pi}}z^{s-1}\partial z = \frac{1}{2}-]$
$\frac{1}{e^{z\pi}-e^{-z\pi}} = \frac{1}{2\pi z}+\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{-yzi}}{e^y+1}\partial y-\frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^\infty\frac{e^{+yzi}}{e^y+1}\partial y$

$1>s>0 \int_0^\infty e^{\pi zzi}\left(\frac{1}{e^{\pi z}-e^{-\pi z}}-\frac{1}{2\pi z}\right)z^{s-1}\partial z = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\int_0^\infty\frac{1}{e^y+1}\partial y\left(\int_0^\infty e^{\pi zzi-yzi}z^{s-1}\partial z-\int\right.$

$1>s>0$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-yy}\int_0^\infty e^{-2yx-xx}x^{s-1}\partial x\,\partial y\,\varepsilon^s = \int_0^\infty\frac{e^{yyi}}{e^{2y\sqrt\pi}+1}\left(\int_0^\infty e^{+2yxi+xxi}x^{s-1}\partial x-\int_0^\infty e^{-2yxi+xxi}x^{s-1}\partial x\right)\frac{\partial y}{\varepsilon}$
$+\frac{1}{2i}\int_0^\infty\frac{1}{e^{2y\sqrt\pi}+1}\partial y\int_0^\infty e^{2yxi+xxi}x^{s-1}\partial x-\int_0^\infty e^{-2}\quad)$

$= -\sqrt\pi\int_0^\infty\left(\frac{1}{e^{2x\sqrt\pi}-1}-\frac{e^{xxi}}{2x\sqrt\pi}\right)x^{s-1}\partial x$

$\int_0^\infty e^{2yxi+xxi}x^{s-1}\partial x = \frac12\sum\frac{(2yi)^n}{n!}\Pi(\frac{n+s}{2}-1)\varepsilon^{n+s} = \frac{1}{2}e^{-\frac{yy}{2}i}(\Pi(\frac{s}{2}-1)u\,\varepsilon^s+\Pi\frac{s-1}{2}u'\,\varepsilon^{s-1})$

methods.what: Asymptotic expansion of a Gaussian-weighted Mellin integral via power series of e^{-xx}
Contour shift of the integral with denominator e^{yε√π}+e^{-yε√π} (ε=e^{πi/4}) picking up a residue, yielding a functional equation for Q
Closed form of the Fourier-type integral
Partial fraction expansion of 1/(2i sin πz) and its integral representation for 0<z<1
Integral representation of 1/(e^{zπ}-e^{-zπ}) minus pole term
Series evaluation of ∫ e^{2yxi+xxi} x^{s-1} dx via Gamma (Π) functions
